title: Training
description: Create courses, lessons and quizzes. Publication makes saved changes available to readers.

course.title: Courses
course.emptyHint: Create a course, then add its lessons.

lesson.title: Lessons
lesson.emptyHint: Add a lesson to this course.

coverImage.label: Cover image
coverImage.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.

course.label: Course
course.hint: Publish this course before publishing its lessons. Moving lessons remains available in the admin panel.

order.label: Order
order.hint: A whole number from 0 to 10,000. Lower numbers come first.

videoUrl.label: YouTube video
videoUrl.hint: Optional HTTPS link to a YouTube video.

validityMonths.label: Validity in months
validityMonths.hint: After this many months the course must be repeated, e.g. 12 for yearly safety training. Empty: once is enough.

contact.label: Questions to
contact.hint: Who answers questions about the course, e.g. "Safety officer Max Muster, ext. 123". Shown on the course page. Empty: nobody named.

departments.label: Departments
departments.hint: Only these departments see the course and must take it. None selected: every employee.

modeHint: All answers are checked by the server. Exam gives only a passed/not-passed result. Attempts are unlimited, with no timer; guessing or sharing answers is still possible.
receiptsNotice: Existing completions stay valid when you change questions, their order or the feedback mode.

quiz.title: Quiz
quiz.limits: Up to {questions} questions, 2–{options} options per question and {characters} characters per text. Select one correct answer for each question.
quiz.invalid: Complete every question and answer, and select one correct answer per question. Check the limits above.
quiz.empty: Without quiz questions, readers mark the lesson complete manually.
